create_ocr_factory_instance: create an OcrFactory instance to manage and instantiate OCR engine models
build_ocr_engine_enum: build a Python enum from registered OCR engine kinds using get_enum
create_ocr_model_instance: create an OCR model instance from BaseOptions using create_instance
register_ocr_model_class: register an OCR model class with its options type for factory use
load_ocr_plugins: load OCR engine plugins from setuptools entrypoints using load_from_plugins
